change_request.close_notes: Migration complete and signed off. Cutover verified; the new tenancy is serving production analytics. Project closed.
change_request.description: Project Atlas migrates the analytics platform to the new cloud tenancy. For the duration of the migration, the delivery squad is granted temporary elevated access across Okta (cloud platform administrator) and GitHub (repository and organisation administration), and a dedicated deployment service account is provisioned. This access is time-boxed to the project and is to be wound back at project close-out.
change_request.short_description: Project Atlas — data platform migration (temporary elevated access)

change_request.close_notes: Migration complete. Temporary access wound back to least privilege: removed the squad from the cloud administrators group AND revoked their directly-assigned admin roles (group removal alone does not drop a direct role); on GitHub, stepped the squad down from organisation owner and team maintainer to member and deleted the project deploy keys; deactivated the Borealis deployment service account and revoked its admin role. Standing administrators and the emergency break-glass account were left in place. Verified no residual elevated access remained.
change_request.description: Project Borealis granted the delivery squad temporary elevated access for the warehouse migration.
change_request.short_description: Project Borealis — warehouse migration (temporary elevated access) — closed out

change_request.close_notes: Access granted for the ongoing on-call rotation.
change_request.description: Grant the incoming SRE on-call engineer standing cloud platform administrator access for the production incident rotation. This is an ongoing operational grant, not time-boxed to a project.
change_request.short_description: SRE on-call rotation — standing production admin (ongoing)

incident.description:
The quarterly access audit flags an excessive number of standing platform administrators following this quarter's platform project close-outs. This is a least-privilege violation: privileged access provisioned for completed work has not been wound back.

Reduce the standing-administrator population to the required minimum and remove the excess privileged access. Preserve documented emergency-access controls. Close this ticket when the review is complete.
incident.short_description: Access audit — excess standing platform administrators (least privilege)
